title: Quote paths with spaces
summary: Quotes keep several words together as one shell argument. This matters when a path contains spaces.
introduction: Quotes keep several words together as one shell argument. This matters when a path contains spaces. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Quotes keep several words together as one shell argument. This matters when a path contains spaces.
The command lists one directory whose name contains a space.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Create another new directory with a space in its name.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Without quotes, the shell may treat a path as several arguments.
For more detail later, use this [Linux further reading](https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/coreutils.html).

seo.title: Linux: Quote paths with spaces
